items.title: Kalshi: Fed decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:06 UTC, the page displayed 50% for “Fed maintains rate” and 48% for “Hike 25bps.”

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:06 UTC, the page displayed 50% for a 25 bp increase and 49% for no change; its rule names the October FOMC statement as resolution source.

items.title: CME FedWatch
items.claim: CME describes FedWatch as probabilities implied by 30-Day Fed Funds futures, but the direct live October grid was unreadable in this check.

items.title: Federal Reserve October calendar
items.claim: The calendar lists September-meeting minutes on October 7 at 14:00 ET and the next FOMC statement on October 28 at 14:00 ET.

items.title: BLS September calendar
items.claim: The calendar lists August Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey on September 29 at 10:00 ET.

items.title: BEA release schedule
items.claim: The schedule lists U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position on September 24 and Personal Income and Outlays on September 30, both at 08:30 ET.
